title: Posting the Room Rate of a Resort Lodging Stay to Its Folio
content:
Where the room rate of a booked Resort Lodging stay falls due on the reservation, it is posted to that reservation's folio as a single room rate entry covering every night of the stay. The household sees one room rate line on the folio carrying the amount, the number of nights it covers and the published rate window the nights were priced in, and the folio balance on the reservation rises by that amount.

## The act and how it is made

The act is the desk agent's own. The tool `post_stay_room_charge_ee3504ba` is unlocked and then called by the agent, with the figure the agent has worked out from the collective's published terms and the records passed in; the tool writes what it is given.

## The parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `lodging_id` | the reference number identifying the Resort Lodging reservation whose folio the room rate is posted to, read from the reservation record the lodging reservation lookup returns |
| `room_charge_amount_usd` | the room rate for the stay that is posted to the folio, in USD, as a decimal amount rounded to 2 decimal places; a value carrying more decimals is stored rounded to the cent |
| `nights_covered` | how many nights of the stay the posted entry covers, given as a whole number of nights with no fractions and no unit text |
| `rate_plan` | the published rate window the nights on this entry were priced in |

The value of `rate_plan` is one of exactly these: `holiday`, used where the nights of the entry are priced at the unit type's holiday nightly rate; `peak`, used where they are priced at its peak nightly rate; `base`, used where they are priced at its base nightly rate; and `none`, which records no rate window at all and is reserved for folio entries that are not room rate entries.

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence on success, carrying the reference number of the folio entry created, the amount in USD posted to the folio, the number of nights the entry covers, the rate window recorded on it and the reservation's folio balance after the posting. Receiving that sentence, with a folio entry reference in it, is what indicates the entry has been written.
